title: Voxel leftover displacement uncertainty on phi, not U-hat
question: After usual T1-dwiref alignment, what is the voxel-wise leftover displacement magnitude and its Hub/Kybic ensemble spread on labeled voxels?
product: maps of voxel-wise median and SD of ||u_k(x)|| in millimetres. Uncertainty on the warp phi. Not a 78x78 probability.

P.reason: This lock has no edge probability and no ECE.

y.reason: No moved event. Do not push phi through assignment under this lock.

source.citation: Hub & Kessler 2009; Kybic 2010. Not Simpson 2012. Not Dalca 2019.

sanity.rule: session median of voxel-wise medians within 0.05 mm of leftover.json splits.transform.syn.M_s
sanity.why: same ensemble, spatial summary; consistency not a new leftover claim

win: All six sessions write phi_median.npy and phi_sd.npy; sanity holds. May claim voxel leftover-mm maps.
fail: missing SyN norms or sanity miss. Keep A5 session M_s. Still not hat{U}.
later_not_this_lock: V2 VoxelMorph / Simpson p(phi|images) needs its own lock and a model. G (gold) needs independent leftover files.
